headline: An independent check confirmed the first three-cycle finding: on one quartic sixfold, the special coefficients for three planes include a conic that no pair of planes explains (first order only). Agents are now looking at second order and for a geometric explanation.

active.title: Three or more cycles: special coefficients
active.state: first-order finding confirmed by a blind check; second order and explanation next
active.summary: For three 3-planes in one P^4 on an explicit quartic sixfold, the coefficients (a0 : a : b) where the tangent space of the Hodge locus jumps are the six lines predicted by pairs PLUS a conic that moves with the hypersurface. Confirmed by an independent check with separate code: exact over QQ at four named points, modulo two primes for the conic itself. Tangent spaces only; nothing yet about the Hodge locus itself. On cubic sixfolds and quartic fourfolds nothing was found off the pairwise lines.

recent.what: Blind check confirmed the conic of special coefficients (first order; exact at named points, mod p for the conic).
Three-cycle target: candidate conic of special coefficients found (exact at one instance); blind check started.

Survey of related work: one-cycle results of Kloosterman (arXiv:2104.14845) and Dan noted; Movasati's 2019 Fermat-surface tables cross-checked (1758 records agree at first order; 42 records differ at second order outside the range, unresolved).
Software package HodgeLociCI 0.1.0 and this discoveries registry published; one blind install check, all 28 findings fixed.
Discovery round closed: explicit families for coefficient -1 (sums of two determinants) and 1 (Pfaffians) on cubic sixfolds; no unexplained piece found for fake linear cycles on quartic sixfolds.
